description_en: Queries information about leaked AccessKey pairs in your assets
description_zh: 查询您资产中已泄露的AccessKey信息
name: DescribeAccesskeyLeakList

parameters.help_en:
The processing status of the leaked AccessKey information that you want to query. Valid values:
pending: unprocessed
dealed: processed
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的已泄露的AccessKey信息的处理状态。取值：
pending：未处理
dealed：已处理
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The AccessKey ID that you want to query. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的AccessKey ID。仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The discovery time of the leaked information that you want to query. All AccessKey leak information discovered after this point in time is returned. This parameter is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的泄露信息的发现时间，可以查询该时间点后发现的所有AccessKey泄露信息。该参数为时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_ts

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. The maximum value of PageSize is 100. The default number of entries per page is 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member account in the resource directory (Alibaba Cloud account).
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

AccessKeyLeakList.description_en: The list of detailed information about leaked AccessKey pairs

AliUserName.description_en: The name of the affected Alibaba Cloud account
AliUserName.description_zh: 受影响的阿里云账号名称

Asset.description_en: The platform where the asset resides. The value is fixed as Cloud Platform
Asset.description_zh: 资产所在的平台，取值固定为云平台

DealTime.description_en: The time when the AccessKey leak information was processed

DealType.description_en:
The method used to handle the AccessKey leak information. Valid values:
pending: unprocessed
manual: manually processed
disable: disabled
add-whitelist: added to the whitelist
DealType.description_zh:
AccessKey泄露信息的处理方式。取值：
pending：未处理
manual：手动处理
disable：禁用
add-whitelist：加入白名单

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the AccessKey leak was first discovered. This parameter is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
GmtModified.description_zh: AccessKey泄露的首次发现时间。该参数为时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

Id.description_en: The primary key ID in the database

Status.description_en:
The processing status of the leaked AccessKey information. Valid values:
pending: unprocessed
dealed: processed
Status.description_zh:
泄露的AccessKey信息的处理状态。取值：
pending：未处理
dealed：已处理

Type.description_en: The type of the leak information. The value is fixed as AccessKey
Type.description_zh: 泄露信息的类型，固定取值为AccessKey

Url.description_en: The URL of the external platform where the AccessKey leak was discovered
Url.description_zh: 发现AccessKey泄露信息的外部平台链接

UserType.description_en:
The type of the account to which the leaked AccessKey pair belongs. Valid values:
master: Alibaba Cloud account
ram: Resource Access Management (RAM) user
UserType.description_zh:
泄露AK的账号类型。取值：
master：阿里云账号
ram：RAM用户

AkLeakCount.description_en: The number of unprocessed AccessKey leak entries
AkLeakCount.description_zh: 未处理的AccessKey泄露信息的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

GmtLast.description_en: This parameter is deprecated and can be ignored
GmtLast.description_zh: 该参数已废弃，无需关注

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页最多显示的数据条数

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of AccessKey leak entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的AccessKey泄露信息的总条数
